hero.eyebrow: Digital Twin Infrastructure for Maritime Operations
hero.headline: From Shipyard Data to Live Vessel Intelligence
hero.subheadline: A'SHERIV builds digital twin infrastructure that connects shipyard production data, vessel operational systems, maintenance records, and targeted sensing into a unified maritime intelligence platform.
hero.supporting: Designed for shipyards, fleet operators, OEMs, insurers, and classification societies.

problem.headline: Maritime Data Exists Everywhere. Operational Intelligence Exists Nowhere.
problem.p1: Shipyards generate build documentation and production records. Operators collect telemetry from vessel systems. Maintenance teams log inspections and repairs. Classification societies require evidence and documentation.
problem.p2: Yet these data streams rarely connect.
problem.p3: A'SHERIV transforms scattered maritime data into a structured digital twin designed for operational clarity, predictive maintenance, and lifecycle accountability.

lifecycle.headline: One Digital Twin Across the Vessel Lifecycle
lifecycle.intro: A vessel's lifecycle spans multiple environments — design offices, shipyards, operational fleets, and maintenance yards. A'SHERIV connects these environments through a continuous intelligence layer.
lifecycle.supporting: By linking shipyard configuration data, operational telemetry, maintenance records, and contextual sensing, A'SHERIV creates a persistent digital twin that evolves alongside the vessel.

solutions.headline: Four Layers of Maritime Intelligence
solutions.intro: A'SHERIV combines shipyard data environments, live vessel-state awareness, maintenance intelligence, and compliance-ready evidence into one operational framework.
solutions.card1Desc: Structure production data, quality checkpoints, and configuration records into traceable operational asset models.
solutions.card2Desc: Transform vessel telemetry, alarms, and logs into a live operational intelligence layer.
solutions.card3Desc: Connect inspections, maintenance records, and risk signals to support evidence-based maintenance planning.
solutions.card4Desc: Generate structured evidence chains for review, claims, audits, and technical decision-making.

platform.headline: Built to Integrate — Not Replace
platform.p1: A'SHERIV integrates with existing maritime systems using secure read-only connectors.
platform.p2: Rather than replacing onboard systems or operational software, the platform aggregates and structures data across multiple sources.
platform.item5: Selective sensing modules where visibility is limited
platform.calloutText: A'SHERIV integrates using secure read-only connectors that extract operational and production data without modifying existing onboard or shipyard systems.

sensors.headline: Selective Sensing Where Visibility Matters
sensors.p1: In many vessels, critical operational insights remain hidden due to missing data points.
sensors.p2: A'SHERIV deploys targeted sensing modules designed to augment existing vessel data environments without invasive system integration.

stakeholders.headline: Built for the Entire Maritime Ecosystem
stakeholders.intro: A'SHERIV creates one shared intelligence layer with role-specific relevance across shipyards, operators, OEMs, insurers, and classification societies.
stakeholders.card1Desc: Improve production traceability, QA linkage, and handover readiness.
stakeholders.card2Desc: Gain continuous operational visibility and maintenance intelligence.
stakeholders.card3Desc: Monitor performance patterns and strengthen design feedback loops.
stakeholders.card4Desc: Access structured evidence and operational context for review.

global.headline: Global Platform. Regional Expertise.
global.intro: A'SHERIV operates through a distributed structure designed to support maritime engineering, digital platform development, and international commercial growth.
global.region1Desc: Shipyard collaboration, production intelligence development, and hardware prototyping.
global.region2Desc: Digital twin architecture, platform development, and AI-driven maritime analytics.
global.region3Desc: Strategic partnerships, commercial expansion, and global market access.

pilot.headline: Deploy a Digital Twin Pilot

about.title: About
about.why1: Maritime operations generate large volumes of data across shipyards, vessels, maintenance teams, and regulatory environments. Yet these data sources remain fragmented across disconnected systems.
about.why2: A'SHERIV addresses this challenge by structuring maritime intelligence across three layers: Build Intelligence for shipyard production data, Operational Intelligence for live vessel telemetry and anomaly detection, and Lifecycle Intelligence connecting design, operations, and maintenance.
about.why3: This architecture enables shipyards, operators, OEMs, insurers, and classification societies to access a consistent digital twin representation of vessel assets across their entire lifecycle.

meta.title: ASHSIM - Ship Information Modelling Intelligence
meta.description: AI analysis and structured build records for shipyards. Connect your CAD workflow to ASHSIM for clash detection, IACS rule compliance, and digital handover.

hero.heading: AI-augmented shipbuilding, without leaving your CAD workflow.
hero.deck: ASHSIM connects to AVEVA Marine, ShipConstructor and CADMATIC. Upload an IFC or STEP export and get instant AI analysis: clash detection, IACS rule compliance, and a structured digital build record.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.deck: ASHSIM sits on top of your existing CAD system. No workflow disruption.

pillar1.title: Export from your CAD
pillar1.body: ASHSIM works with AVEVA Marine, ShipConstructor and CADMATIC. One-click IFC or STEP export from your existing design system.

pillar2.title: AI analysis in minutes
pillar2.body: Upload to ASHSIM. Get an instant report: geometric clash detection, IACS steel grade verification, element completeness, and prioritised recommendations.

pillar3.title: Structured build record
pillar3.body: Every finding, drawing, weld, and NCR stays in one place. At delivery, generate a complete digital handover package for the owner.

card1.title: IFC model analysis
card1.body: Geometric clash detection with AABB tolerance, IACS steel grade verification, element completeness checks, and anomaly detection across the structural model.

card2.title: Technical drawings
card2.body: Upload PDFs and drawing exports. AI extracts dimensions, revision history, and compliance notes. Class approval status tracked per drawing.

card3.title: Construction workflow
card3.body: Optional modules for block tracking, welding QC, NCR management, milestones, equipment register, and material certificates.

compliance.heading: Built for classification
compliance.body: ASHSIM outputs align with IACS structural rules and support survey witness records for DNV, BV, LR, ABS, and Turk Loydu handover packages.
